item.title: Reddit is turning user conversations into AI-powered product reviews
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Reddit's new AI-powered reviews summarize what users like and dislike about 10,000 products, helping shoppers research purchases ahead of the holidays.

item.title: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.

item.title: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan, Ram Iyer
item.description: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.

item.title: Aura’s newest e-ink photo frame is even better and more affordable than its last
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: Aura is unveiling a new product: a 10-inch digital e-ink frame that can blend in seamlessly with printed photos.

item.title: After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Kora is set to launch as a free-to-use alternative to Windows, targeting users who rely heavily on AI models and agents.

item.title: Spotify’s AI DJ gets new voices, personalities, and an option for less chatter
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Spotify Premium users can now customize their AI DJ with new voices with different personalities, or turn off the commentary between songs.

item.title: Ring, known for its doorbell cameras, launches a home security drone and an enterprise security robot
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Amazon-owned Ring is pushing into robotics with the launch of a home security drone and a rolling robot designed to patrol and protect businesses.

item.title: Cyberattacks threaten to make open-source AI a little less open, Hugging Face exec warns
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Hugging Face executive Irene Solaiman warns that growing cyberattacks on open AI platforms could force tighter security restrictions, threatening the accessibility that makes open-source communities valuable to developers worldwide.

item.title: Otter AI can now follow conversations across 30+ languages
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: Otter AI just added support for 27 languages and revealed an upcoming feature that can follow along if speakers switch between languages.

item.title: California’s proposed ‘billionaire tax’ fails to pass
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: California voters rejected Proposition 40, the one-time 5% tax on billionaires, the AP reported Monday. Tech leaders outspent backers roughly 10 to 1 to defeat it, and the founders and economists TechCrunch interviewed before the vote were split on whether it would have driven out wealthy residents or just trimmed their fortunes.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s alleged honeypot scandal has inspired some top-notch memes
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis, Lucas Ropek
item.description: The internet is having a field day with Nvidia's Jensen Huang's alleged honeypot scandal.

item.title: Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.

item.title: Jensen Huang reportedly engaged a PR firm with a history of handling high-profile sex scandals a year ago
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The PR firm was enlisted shortly after an October 2025 New York Times report described Alice Huang's business dealings with Jensen Huang, Wired reported.

item.title: Hotel giant Wyndham exposed customer data after app security lapse
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: Exclusive: Wyndham left a hardcoded credential in its customer app, allowing anyone to access customer data. The hotel giant wouldn't say if it has the ability to check for any past unauthorized access.

item.title: A short seller flagged Nvidia CEO’s ties to a suspected Chinese spy six months before the scandal
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Six months before Nvidia's spy scandal erupted, Culper Research was already questioning Jensen Huang's unusually close relationship with a Chinese executive.

item.title: The race is on to sue Nvidia
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: Nvidia’s stock slid more than 4% after its board opened an investigation into Jensen Huang’s relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, and one securities law expert says the company’s earlier insistence that it was all “normal” could turn into a very expensive problem.

item.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Geothermal company Fervo is targeting natural gas as it brings down geothermal drilling costs at its 8.4 GW resource in Utah.

item.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
item.dc:creator: Ivan Mehta
item.description: The Nvidia CEO also pulled out of an Anthropic event earlier.

item.title: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
item.dc:creator: Lauren Forristal
item.description: YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027 after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.

item.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Anthropic says the new models "show improvements in areas like coding, reasoning, and vision," as well as in communicating more clearly with users.
